newsitem.title: USA: Expeditors names Silva as Latam MD.
newsitem.headline: Expeditors names Silva as Latam MD.

text.p: Freight forwarder Expeditors International said it has appointed Idevaldo Silva as managing director, Latin America, responsible for the company's office and agent network throughout the region.
The company said in a statement that Silva has previously been manager of business development, Latin America, based in San Francisco.,

It added that Bob Koplowitz has joined the company as director of its global account management program, while Simon Chu has been hired as director of North American operations for Expeditors Cargo Management Systems, a division providing ocean consolidation services. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
